Task Guide:

Simulate the fracture behavior of a Σ3(111) symmetric tilt grain boundary (STGB) in body-centered cubic (BCC) iron using LAMMPS. The simulation should begin by reading a pre-generated grain boundary structure file (present at /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt) that defines a bicrystal with a tilt direction of <110> and a grain boundary plane of <111>. The simulation should use metal units and atome_style atomic, and box should have periodic boundary conditions in all directions. After initialization, perform an energy minimization using the conjugate gradient (CG) algorithm with force and energy tolerances of 1.0e-15 and a maximum of 1000 iterations and use the EAM potential present at (/potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs). The box should be allowed to relax along the x and z directions while maintaining a fixed y-direction. Following minimization, apply uniaxial tensile loading perpendicular to the grain boundary (y-direction). Atoms far from the boundary should be deleted to avoid artifacts, and atoms at the edges should be fixed before the deformation begins. The strain should be applied in increments, with the fixed groups being displaced incrementally, followed by energy minimization at each step. During the simulation, compute the stress tensor components and store stress-strain data in a text file called stress_strain.txt. The file should contain strain values and stress components converted from bars to GPa in the format strain,stress_xx,stress_yy,stress_zz without any column names or metadata. As the final result, report the maximum tensile stress (in GPa) along the x-direction achieved prior to the onset of plastic deformation or structural instability, identified as the first significant drop in the stress-strain response. Make sure all the associated files for this task (input files, log files, any other files) are in the /results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/brief/task_9/task_9_trial_0 directory. You can use the available I/O tools (e.g., write_file) make new files .etc. Whatever potentials you need to run the simulation, you can find them at /potentials/. A type of potential can be accessed by /potentials/TYPE where TYPE can be [EAM, TERSOFF, REAXFF] which further contains the exact potential files. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL. If the task is to give the final output as a scalar, only return the numerical value, without any units.

{"path": "/results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/brief/task_9/task_9_trial_0/in.tensile", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Initial minimization
fix             1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix           1

# Define groups for fixed regions and delete atoms far from boundary
region          top block INF INF 0.85 INF INF INF
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.15 INF INF
region          middle block INF INF 0.15 0.85 INF INF
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           middle region middle

# Delete atoms far from boundary to avoid artifacts
group           tobedeleted subtract all middle
delete_atoms    group tobedeleted

# Setup for tensile deformation
variable        strain equal 0.0
variable        strain_rate equal 0.0001
variable        N equal 100    # number of strain increments
variable        dt equal 0.001

# Output settings
variable        stress_xx equal pxx
variable        stress_yy equal pyy
variable        stress_zz equal pzz

fix             2 all print 1 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain_raw.txt

# Deformation loop
label           loop
variable        i loop ${N}
    # Increment strain
    variable    strain equal ${strain}+${strain_rate}
    
    # Apply displacement to fixed groups
    displace_atoms top move 0.0 ${strain} 0.0
    
    # Minimize energy
    minimize    1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    
next           i
jump           in.tensile loop

# Convert stress values from bars to GPa and write final output
print          "All done""}

{"path": "/results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/brief/task_9/task_9_trial_0/in.tensile", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Read structure
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Energy minimization
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step pe lx ly lz press pxx pyy pzz
min_style       cg
fix             1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix           1

region          top block INF INF 0.85 INF INF INF units box
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.15 INF INF units box
region          middle block INF INF 0.15 0.85 INF INF units box
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           middle region middle
group           boundary union top bottom
group           mobile subtract all boundary

# Delete unnecessary atoms
group           tobedeleted subtract all middle
delete_atoms    group tobedeleted

# Setup for tensile deformation
variable        strain equal 0.0
variable        strain_rate equal 0.0001
variable        N equal 100

# Compute stress in GPa
variable        s_xx equal pxx*1.0e-4
variable        s_yy equal pyy*1.0e-4
variable        s_zz equal pzz*1.0e-4

# Output stress-strain data
fix             ss_out all print 1 "${strain} ${s_xx} ${s_yy} ${s_zz}" file stress_strain.txt

# Deformation loop
label           loop
variable        i loop ${N}
    # Increment strain
    variable    strain equal ${strain}+${strain_rate}
    
    # Move top group
    displace_atoms top move 0.0 ${strain} 0.0
    
    # Minimize with fixed boundary
    fix          2 boundary setforce 0.0 0.0 0.0
    min_style    cg
    minimize     1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    unfix        2
    
next           i
jump           in.tensile loop

print          "All done""}
